I am an old woman now, 57 years, and I have farmed this land my whole life without schooling. This small maize plot near the house is only a quarter of a hectare, but it feeds my family, so I must care for it well. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative like my neighbors do, and I will carry manure from our cattle to spread on it before planting. I cannot afford irrigation or much hired help, so I rely on the rains of Meher and my own hands, with my children helping at planting and harvest.
